# Beelink SER8 AMD Ryzen™ 7 8845HS — Mini PC

**Category:** Desktop computer (Mini PC)

**MSRP:** $799.00 (32GB DDR5 + 1TB SSD configuration; 24GB and 64GB configs also available)

## Tech Specs

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| CPU | AMD Ryzen™ 7 8845HS, 8-core/16-thread, 3.8GHz–5.1GHz, 16MB L3 cache, TSMC 4nm FinFET (Zen 4) |
| GPU | AMD Radeon™ 780M, 12 cores, 2700MHz, RDNA 3 architecture |
| NPU | Ryzen AI Engine, 16 TOPS AI performance |
| Memory | Dual SO-DIMM DDR5 5600MHz slots, max 256GB (24GB/32GB/64GB stock configs) |
| Storage | Dual M.2 2280 PCIe 4.0 x4 slots, max 8TB (4TB × 2) |
| Display Output | HDMI 2.1 + DisplayPort 1.4 + full-featured USB4; triple-display, 4K @144Hz support |
| Networking | 2.5Gbps LAN, WiFi 6 (Intel AX200), Bluetooth 5.2 |
| Cooling | MSC 2.0 cooling system — vapor chamber, silent fan, dedicated SSD heatsink |
| Noise Level | 32dB (near-silent operation) |
| TDP | 65W (configurable between 54W and 65W modes) |
| Power Adapter | Input: 100–240V AC, 50/60Hz; Output: 19V 5.26A |
| Dimensions & Weight | 0.814L chassis volume; 0.75kg |
| Operating System | Windows 11 Pro (pre-installed) |
| Additional Features | Auto power-on, Wake-on-LAN (WOL) |
| Warranty | 3-year warranty |

## Notable Features

- CPU, GPU, and NPU integrated on a single chip, combining strong multi-threaded performance with AI acceleration for demanding workloads
- Vapor-chamber-based MSC 2.0 cooling system keeps the system near-silent (32dB) even at 65W sustained TDP
- Dual M.2 PCIe 4.0 slots and dual DDR5 SO-DIMM slots give substantial upgrade headroom (up to 8TB storage, 256GB RAM)
- Triple 4K display output at up to 144Hz via HDMI 2.1, DisplayPort 1.4, and USB4
- High-density metal dust filter on the intake to reduce internal dust accumulation over time
- Sub-1-liter, sub-1kg chassis suitable for space-constrained desks or homelab racks
